headline: Japan Electricity Spot Prices Surge to Highest Level Since August 2022
summary: Spot electricity prices in Japan rose 6% on Monday to hit their highest level since August 2022. Cold weather forecasts and higher expected gas demand in Chubu and Hokkaido drove the price increase.
why: Japan relies heavily on imported natural gas for power generation, making domestic electricity prices sensitive to winter weather demand.

impacts.name: Japan Day-Ahead Electricity
impacts.why: Japan day-ahead electricity prices rose 6% due to cold weather and higher expected gas demand.
